## Analysis

The prescribed annealing improved 1.059793 to 1.073430, confirming that exact-score local mutation can strengthen sum dominance, but it recovered only a small fraction of the gap to 1.144887. Despite allowing sizes 12–40, its best remained at n=17, so unconstrained add/delete mutations provided no demonstrated benefit. The 67-sum/61-difference endpoint suggests the main limitation is structural: arbitrary sparse-set mutations rarely coordinate the many additive collisions needed for a large exponent.
